name: Glass Prince
source:
A fantasy story exploring the theme of power and destruction.

"How did he get to this point? 

Once he’s created this indestructible connection, Yorgas promised himself never to tempt fate again. Because obviously it didn’t go well last time. But today at the boy’s coronation he realized that he got trapped once again. Adalstein connected them all with the blood magic. Even thought not so tight, it was more than enough for the rest of the Demons to stand by the Prince’s side. Yorgas was infuriated by this."

[from [url=https://katy-panoff.itch.io/glass-prince]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个探索权力与破坏主题的奇幻故事。

“他是怎么走到这一步的？

一旦建立了这种坚不可摧的联系，约加斯就向自己保证，再也不会试探命运了。因为显然上次的事情并不顺利。但今天在男孩的加冕典礼上，他意识到自己再次陷入困境。阿达尔斯坦用血魔法将它们联系起来。即使没有那么紧，对于其他魔族来说，站在王子身边也绰绰有余了。约加斯对此感到愤怒。”

[来自[url=https://katy-panoff.itch.io/glass-prince]itch.io[/url]]
